item.subject: science
item.chapter_label: The world of metals and non-metals
item.stem:
Meera uses a circuit tester with a small bulb to check four objects found at home during a power cut in her village. When she touches the tester wires to each object, she records whether the bulb glows.

Object 1: iron nail – bulb glows
Object 2: dry wooden scale – bulb does not glow
Object 3: aluminium key – bulb glows
Object 4: rubber eraser – bulb does not glow

Meera wants to know which objects she could safely hold with bare hands while touching a live wire, because they will not let electricity pass through to her body.

Which objects are safe to hold?
